::: {.stand}
We create spaces, online and in person, where people can move, breathe,
connect and learn together. They are for practitioners, and for anyone who is
curious about their body.
:::
::::

::: {.band .band-front}
:::

Notknowing Garden is run by [FG](about/fg.qmd) and [DS](about/ds.qmd). We
create these spaces together, and in them we bring yoga and tantra into one
practice.

::: {.ways}
[What you will find here]{.eyebrow}

::: {.way}
[Gatherings]{.k}

These are spaces to practise and learn together, online and in person. The
first ones coming up are two retreats in 2027: [Practitioners'
Circle](community/practitioners-circle.qmd), for practitioners who want to
lead groups, and [Moving Together](community/moving-together.qmd), a movement
retreat for anyone.

[see what is coming up →](community/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.way}
[Writing]{.k}

We write long reading guides to the research on touch, pain and breathing.
Each one looks at what is known, what is not, and what it means in practice.

[read the writing →](writing/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.way}
[The podcast]{.k}

The podcast will be a series of conversations with people who work with the
body, hosted by the two of us. There are no episodes yet.

[about the podcast →](podcast/index.qmd)
:::
:::
